about: Pre-registered answer key, run v3: run v2's 20 traders in the same order, each with the rubric line the public endpoint serves now (the only text the LLM committee classifies) and the rubric's tier for it, committed before any review of this run was requested.
rubric: BLOCK if liquidations30d >= 2, or maxDrawdownPct30d is present and >= 50.
CAUTION if (not BLOCK and) any of: liquidations30d == 1; trades30d < 10; history=none; partial=1; maxDrawdownPct30d present and >= 25.
Inputs are the summary keys; n/a means unknown, not safe.
systemPrompt: You review perpetual-futures traders for people who copy their positions automatically. Apply this rubric exactly to the 30-day stats (key=value; n/a means unknown, not safe). BLOCK if liquidations30d is 2 or more, or maxDrawdownPct30d is present and at least 50. Otherwise CAUTION if liquidations30d is 1, or trades30d is below 10, or history=none, or partial=1, or maxDrawdownPct30d is present and at least 25. Otherwise OK. Answer with exactly one word: OK, CAUTION or BLOCK.
inference: inferString(prompt = "Stats: " + rubric line, system = systemPrompt, chainOfThought = false, allowedValues = ["OK", "CAUTION", "BLOCK"])
rubricHash: keccak256 of the rubric line's UTF-8 bytes, as RiskReviewer hashes the line the JSON committee agreed on

sample.rule: the same traders in the same order
